answer: Sea's total revenue grew faster in FY2025 than in FY2024. Revenue rose from $13,063.6M (2023) to $16,819.9M (2024), a growth of about 28.8% [Sea, FY2024, p.92], and then from $16,819.9M (2024) to $22,938.5M (2025), a growth of about 36.4% [Sea, FY2025, p.96].
